title: Pushforward from an open of a coherent module with support closed in the ambient scheme is coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $j:U\to X$ the inclusion of an open subscheme and $T\subseteq X$ a closed subset with $T\subseteq U$. If $\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module [pqf-def-coherent] with $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\subseteq T$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then the pushforward $j_*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; indeed $(j_*\mathcal F)|_U=\mathcal F$ and $(j_*\mathcal F)|_{X\setminus T}=0$ (restrictions to open subschemes as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0CYJ (lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open) and its proof

proof.text: Restrict the pushforward back to U using Mathlib Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso. This supplies the isomorphism with F directly, without the tensor pullback construction.

For an open V of the complement of T, sections of the restricted pushforward are sections of F on the inverse image under U.ι of the image of V. Every point in this open lies outside T, hence hSupp implies its stalk is subsingleton. Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext makes each section equal to zero. Extensionality gives identity equals zero, and IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero proves the restriction is zero. This uses Mathlib stalks directly; no separately defined module-stalk functor or proper-support construction is needed.

Construct the two-element open cover indexed by ULift Bool: true maps to U, false to the complement of T. The containment T subset U proves its supremum is top. Transport hF across the restriction-back isomorphism; transport coherence of zero across the zero restriction isomorphism. Both coherence transports and coherence of zero are the corresponding clauses of coherent_kernel_cokernel_sum. Apply the local-on-open-cover clause of coherent_module_local_on_open_cover and combine the three conclusions.
